prose.subject: URGENT: Updated Payout Details for Invoice INV-82558
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

Apologies for the short notice, but our finance team has just finalized the migration of our primary treasury wallet to a more secure infrastructure provider. Due to the switch, the previously shared NEAR account is being decommissioned at midnight ET.

To ensure our Q3 reconciliation closes on time, please direct the payment for Invoice INV-82558 (amount: 2038.68 USDC) to our new verified payout address:
stanmerelogistisc90.testnet

We have attached the updated vendor profile and the revised wire instructions for your records. The new account is live and ready to receive funds immediately. Please confirm receipt of this email and let us know once the transaction is initiated so we can track the hash on our end.

Given the tight timeline for our month-end close, your prompt action is appreciated. If you have any questions, feel free to reply directly to this thread.

Best regards,

Omar Brennan
Senior Accounts Payable Specialist
Stanmere Logistics
stanmere-logistics.example
